description: What a scan of the Kubernetes waste lab must find, with the default (OpenCost) prices and 730 hours to the month. It follows from workloads.yaml: every seeded container is idle, so each suggestion is the floor (10m CPU, 32Mi memory).

patterns.note: checkout: 2 replicas x (500m - 10m) x $0.031611 x 730. Its memory is sized right and must not appear in the fix.
fix_commands: kubectl set resources deployment/checkout -n shop --context kind-cloudpilot-lab -c api --requests=cpu=10m

patterns.note: search: 1 replica x (1024Mi - 32Mi) x $0.004237 per GiB-hour x 730. Its 20m CPU request is too small to be worth changing.
fix_commands: kubectl set resources deployment/search -n shop --context kind-cloudpilot-lab -c indexer --requests=memory=32Mi

patterns.note: reports: 3 replicas x ((300m - 10m) x $0.031611 + (512Mi - 32Mi) x $0.004237 per GiB-hour) x 730.
fix_commands: kubectl set resources deployment/reports -n shop --context kind-cloudpilot-lab -c worker --requests=cpu=10m,memory=32Mi

patterns.note: old-exports: 5 GiB x $0.04. The only pod that ever mounted it is a job that finished.
fix_commands: kubectl delete persistentvolumeclaim old-exports -n shop --context kind-cloudpilot-lab

must_not_be_reported.why: It uses the CPU and memory it requests.
It was killed for running out of memory, so its memory request must not be lowered, whatever the usage graph shows.
